statements.statement: Business manager reported ESSER SR2/SR3 projected spending totals, leaving a surplus.
Governor's budget expected around March 1st, later than usual, so local aid figures come later.

warnings.condition: when ESSER funds are no longer available
warnings.prediction: When ESSER funds end, key positions will have to be incorporated into the local budget and some difficult decisions and staffing cuts may be needed.
Current staffing levels targeting needs may not be maintainable; a Plan B minus the staffing.

warnings.condition: if the district did not participate in school choice
warnings.prediction: Without school choice the account would dwindle to zero and contractual benefits would have to be covered by the local budget.
